benchmark_selection_basis: simulator-only validity; no FastWAM inference has been run on any move_block_reveal_can version
bug_classification: scripted-expert implementation robustness; not a scene, condition, difficulty, success, or policy-performance change
reason: V0.3.1 reset passed every occlusion, pairing, contact, stability, and visibility assertion, but its locally simplified can-to-basket scripted expert produced only 5/9 final physical successes despite paired-identical Visible/Oracle handoff states. V0.3.2 replaces only that simplified downstream expert method with the exact native place_can_basket.play_once sequence, including the native opposite-arm basket grasp/lift tail requested for maximum upstream reuse.

evidence.reset_audit: simulator/reset_audit.json: passed for all three seeds and all conditions
evidence.expert_audit: simulator/expert_audit.json: 5/9; all four failures were final can-placement physical failures, with no reset/visibility/pairing failure
evidence.cross_condition_nondeterminism: seed 4300001 Visible failed while paired-identical Oracle succeeded; seed 4300002 Visible succeeded while paired-identical Oracle failed

unchanged_from_v0_3_1: can and basket assets, sampling, masses, and arm choice
opaque body and grasp-cap dimensions, relative pose, mass, color, and contact candidates
visible, missing, and oracle_reveal definitions and five handoff physics steps
instruction, task config, horizon, all seed manifests, admission thresholds, and GPU protocol
instruction: Put the can into the basket.

occluder.implementation: one dynamic rigid actor with procedural opaque body and procedural grasp cap; matching visual and collision geometry

conditions.shared_base: all conditions construct and settle the block at occluding_pose using the same seed and code path
conditions.visible: move only block to revealed_pose, zero block velocity, advance five physics steps before first observation
conditions.missing: leave block at occluding_pose and advance the same five physics steps
conditions.oracle_reveal: start identical to Missing, then apply the exact Visible block-only intervention before first observation

visibility.missing: can pixels == 0 separately in head, left wrist, and right wrist
visibility.visible_and_oracle: at least one camera has >= 32 can pixels

task_configuration.success: basket upright; can center inside basket; can contacts basket; can-side gripper open; can touches neither gripper; relative can/basket motion is stable for 25 consecutive physics steps; block is ignored

scripted_expert.missing: grasp/lift/translate/release block, return arm home, then native place_can_basket.play_once
scripted_expert.oracle_reveal: oracle block-only handoff, then native place_can_basket.play_once

native_approximate_block_calibration.evidence_boundary: same 0.06 m grasp cross-section/contact orientations; not an exact compound-body or reveal-sequence calibration

evaluation_plan_frozen_before_fastwam.admission_rule: freeze after reset and scripted expert pass; run both native calibrations once; run paired three-condition pilot only if both thresholds pass; never change task parameters from policy results

gpu_protocol.guard: before every launch save full nvidia-smi, compute-app, and pmon evidence and refuse any non-Xorg process
gpu_protocol.isolation: SAPIEN by physical PCI address, CUDA by UUID, bubblewrap device-node allowlist
